description.short_caption: Gram stain showing gram-positive branching filamentous organisms.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain with pink and purple staining. Notable are branching filamentous structures consistent with gram-positive organisms. The background contains cellular debris and scattered material. The branching morphology is characteristic of certain bacterial genera, such as Nocardia or Actinomyces.

description.short_caption: Fungal elements seen on a stained preparation.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a stained preparation with fungal elements visible. The fungal structures appear as branching, filamentous hyphae, stained in a darker color against a lighter background. The preparation suggests a fungal infection, and the stain highlights the morphology of the organism. The image is de-identified and does not provide anatomical context.
